raw_response: {"diagnosis": "As of 2026-01-18, the payments source sends amount corrections in the daily delivery as repeated txn_id rows with record_version incremented (30 rows at version 2). silver_transactions keeps every version, so 30 txn_ids are duplicated and the gold aggregates double-count them.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.87, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) latest WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
